stories.summary: Every piece of AI content from Google's Gemini models has a hidden SynthID label, which makes it very difficult to pass the content off as authentic . SynthID has also gotten buy-in from other major AI players, but actually checking for those invisible waterma
points: Every piece of AI content from Google's Gemini models has a hidden SynthID label, which makes it very difficult to pass the content off as authentic .
SynthID has also gotten buy-in from other major AI players, but actually checking for those invisible watermarks has been a convoluted process.
It's going to be a little easier going forward, though.
